deltas.section: Product Family (NEW section or expansion of existing)
deltas.content: chain: product family formalised as three layers: (1) chain:SENTRY — blockchain forensics / investigative workbench (this document's subject, CyberDSA-ready); (2) chain:HARVEST — Digital Asset Tracing MCP, formally connected to the roadmap as the NEXT product in the family, sequenced after SENTRY MVP milestones (was incubation-only since 14 Aug announcement); (3) chain:IDENTITY — identity assurance layer, future roadmap, R&D pipeline via UKM MyVAM collaboration.

Digital Asset Tracing MCP: cross-chain asset tracing/recovery (extends SENTRY's EVM-only tracing), MCP architecture for AI-agent integration, asset-recovery use cases (following assets across chains and mechanisms). Status: roadmap-planned, pre-specification. Sequenced after chain:SENTRY Phase 1-3 milestones.

Identity assurance capabilities entering future roadmap: MyKad microprint + hologram detection (document forensics), deepfake/AI detection + liveness randomisation for human videos, face-matching + OCR for ID data extraction with tamper prevention. R&D engine: UKM MyVAM Deepfake Detection Project collaboration (university cohort). E-KYC is the capability description; chain:IDENTITY is the product name. Note: resource allocation (AI tokens/GPU) deferred until after CyberDSA 2026.

ChainSentry database is populated from a gathered intelligence corpus spanning: (a) full cybercrime threat spectrum — ransomware, scams, sextortion; (b) AML intelligence from APAC, MENA (Middle East), and BRICS countries. This regional diversity (esp. MENA + BRICS corridors underserved by Western vendors) is a stated differentiator for sovereign positioning and Malaysian enforcement priorities (MAPO, scam-centre proliferation).
